posts.zh:
dsh-desktop-launcher 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

posts.en:
dsh-desktop-launcher is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0842af42621233fd1eba.html
